_readme: The browsable facets a parent picks from. Lowercase phrases in plain English — 'letting others help', never 'humility'. NOTE: currently one value per story (70), which makes it a list rather than a facet. Consolidating to roughly 25 shared values is an editorial task before launch; the validator warns on anything outside this file so the drift stays visible.
